```{r setup, message=FALSE}
source("00_requirements.R")
source("01_funct_DataCleaning.R")
```

The project uses two csv files from the folder: the top quarterbacks of each season
(2021-2025, with team win percentage and an MVP indicator) and the list of MVP winners.
```{r load}
qb      <- load_qb_data("candidates_21-25.csv")
winners <- load_winners_data("MVP-winners_21-25.csv")
dim(qb)
winners
head(qb)
```

## Check for missing values and duplicates
```{r quality}
colSums(is.na(qb))
sum(duplicated(qb[, c("season", "player_id")]))   # expect 0
```

## Check that each season has exactly one MVP
```{r winners}
check_winners(qb)
```

## Check the MVP indicator against the winners file
```{r winners-match}
mvp_in_data <- qb |> filter(mvp == 1) |> select(season, player_name)
anti_join(winners, mvp_in_data, by = c("season", "player_name"))
anti_join(mvp_in_data, winners, by = c("season", "player_name"))
```

## Create new variables
Per-game versions of each statistic make QBs comparable even when games played differ.
Within-season ranks show where each QB stands against his own competition.
```{r features}
qb <- qb |>
  add_qb_features() |>
  add_season_ranks(stats = c("pass_yds_pg", "pass_td_pg", "pass_int_pg",
                             "td_int_ratio", "rush_yds_pg", "win_pct"))
glimpse(qb)
```

```{r save}
save(qb, winners, file = "12_DataSaving.RData")
```
